svg.text: T-06 · The Crescent, the Academy: floor plans
The palace's dome at the bottom, the garden at the top. Classrooms face the garden; the corridor runs along the dome side.
Upper floor · level with the palace's floor and the winter garden
doors in from the winter garden
Lower floor · 5.6 m down, level with the garden gallery and the upper garden dome
low stone wall, glass roof over
toward the palace and the start
